name: #general with the GIF picker expanded on Trending

regions_read.verdict_on_region: names the channel the user is in ('# general' in the top bar, with the '#' channel sign) — a place name, counted
names the GIF category open inside the picker, beside a back chevron; locates within the picker, while '# general' stays visible dimmed above — counted as a sub-location

Emoji / GIFs / Stickers tab row of the expression picker; the current tab is drawn with a grey fill (declared: 'GIFs') and the fill followed each tab tapped live — locates within the picker only, counted as a sub-location

initial_rationale: top bar '# general' names the channel and stays visible (dimmed where a sheet covers the lower screen); picker/sheet headings name the panel

test_cases.precondition: #general with the picker open on GIFs
test_cases.action: drag the picker to full height, scroll the GIF grid two screens, then scroll back
test_cases.expected_result: '# general' stays visible above the sheet and the GIFs tab stays highlighted
test_cases.confirms_if: the channel name is covered with no other place name, and does not return
test_cases.overturns_if: channel name stays visible or returns
test_cases.observed_result: '# general' stayed visible, dimmed, above the full-height sheet throughout; the Emoji / GIFs / Stickers row stayed pinned with GIFs filled while the grid scrolled; nothing was lost

deciding_evidence: tested live: '# general' stayed visible, dimmed, above the full-height sheet throughout; the Emoji / GIFs / Stickers row stayed pinned with GIFs filled while the grid scrolled; nothing was lost
